articles.title: Northern Ireland Earn Nations League Promotion After Hungary Draw
articles.summary: Northern Ireland manager Michael O'Neill praised his team's character and self-belief after they fought back from a goal down against Hungary. The hard-fought draw secured the crucial point required to finish top of their group, confirming their promotion to the top tier of the Nations League.

articles.title: Bellamy Backs Wales Despite Nations League Defeat to Portugal
articles.summary: Wales manager Craig Bellamy remains confident in his squad's abilities despite suffering a defeat against Portugal. Although the result left Wales at the bottom of their Nations League group, Bellamy maintained that the performance proved his players possess the necessary quality to compete at the highest international level.

articles.title: Wayne Rooney Opens Up on Mental Health Struggles at Man Utd
articles.summary: Former Manchester United forward Wayne Rooney has revealed that he contemplated taking his own life during his playing days at the club. The ex-England international explained that he sought professional therapy during this difficult period to better understand and work through the mental health challenges he was experiencing.

articles.title: Troy Parrott Celebrates Standout Year Following Kosovo Double
articles.summary: Republic of Ireland forward Troy Parrott reflected on a remarkable twelve-month period for club and country after netting two goals in a victory over Kosovo. The striker highlighted the transformative nature of his recent form, expressing satisfaction with his personal development and key contributions to the national side.

articles.title: Voting Opens for BBC Women's Footballer of the Year 2026
articles.summary: Voting has officially commenced for the BBC Women's Footballer of the Year award for 2026. A shortlist featuring five nominated players has been revealed, giving supporters the chance to cast their votes and decide who will claim the prestigious individual accolade.

articles.title: Former Arsenal Double Winner Peter Storey Dies at 81
articles.summary: Peter Storey, the former Arsenal and England midfielder, has passed away at the age of 81. Storey was an integral component of the celebrated Gunners squad that achieved the historic First Division and FA Cup Double during the 1970-71 campaign.

articles.title: Teenager JJ Gabriel Bids Farewell to Manchester United
articles.summary: Manchester United prospect JJ Gabriel has posted a farewell message to the club ahead of an anticipated switch to Real Madrid. The teenager expressed gratitude for his time at Old Trafford, noting that the club will permanently remain an important part of his footballing journey.

articles.title: Prolific Former Rangers Striker Ralph Brand Passes Away at 89
articles.summary: Rangers have paid tribute following the death of their former forward Ralph Brand at the age of 89. Brand established himself as one of the most prolific goalscorers in the Scottish club's history, earning legendary status for his memorable attacking exploits during his time at Ibrox.

articles.title: Liverpool Lead Camara Chase as Barcelona Dismiss Transfer Links
articles.summary: Liverpool are reportedly ahead of Premier League rivals Chelsea in the pursuit of Monaco midfielder Lamine Camara. Elsewhere, Barcelona have firmly dismissed interest in signing Virgil van Dijk or Bruno Fernandes, while former Crystal Palace winger Wilfried Zaha is linked with a potential return to Selhurst Park.

articles.title: Remembering the Era of the Rest of the World XI
articles.summary: Reflecting on football history, elite players such as Diego Maradona, Ronaldo, and Roberto Baggio once regularly teamed up in their prime to represent the Rest of the World XI. Such high-profile exhibition fixtures have since vanished, seeming virtually impossible to stage in today's crowded calendar.

articles.title: Izzy Goodwin Earns Maiden Senior England Call-Up
articles.summary: London City Lionesses attacker Izzy Goodwin has been handed her first senior international call-up for England. The forward was selected by Sarina Wiegman as part of the Lionesses squad tasked with contesting the World Cup qualifying play-off tie against Ukraine.

articles.title: PFA Chief Maheta Molango Warns Football Is Facing Critical Dangers
articles.summary: Professional Footballers' Association chief executive Maheta Molango has issued a stern warning about the future of football, asserting that the game is in danger of losing touch with its core values. Molango also expressed serious concerns over player welfare and labeled the handling of the Folarin Balogun situation as scandalous.

articles.title: Carlos Forbs Strikes Winner as Portugal Edge Wales
articles.summary: Portugal secured victory over Wales thanks to a decisive goal from second-half substitute Carlos Forbs. Wearing the altered number seven jersey designed to honor Cristiano Ronaldo's legacy, Forbs delivered a high-quality finish to claim a hard-fought win for the Portuguese side in an eventful post-Ronaldo encounter.

articles.title: Justin Devenny Wonder Strike Seals Promotion for Northern Ireland
articles.summary: Northern Ireland achieved promotion to the Nations League top flight after securing a 1-1 draw against Hungary. After trailing, Stoke's Justin Devenny leveled with a sensational edge-of-the-box volley to preserve first place in Group B2. Elsewhere, Erling Haaland's late penalty advanced Norway, and Troy Parrott's penalties helped Ireland reach a playoff.

articles.title: Arsenal Pay Tribute to Double-Winning Legend Peter Storey
articles.summary: Arsenal are mourning the loss of Peter Storey, who died at 81. The versatile midfielder made 501 appearances for the Gunners, ranking eighth on the club's all-time list, and was an essential member of Bertie Mee's 1970-71 Double-winning side before finishing his career at Fulham and earning 19 England caps.

articles.title: Wayne Rooney Discusses Darkest Mental Health Struggles at United
articles.summary: Wayne Rooney has shared candid details regarding his mental health during his time at Manchester United, revealing he reached a low point where he contemplated suicide. Despite on-pitch success, marriage, and fatherhood, Rooney struggled privately, often drinking alone for days at home before seeking professional guidance to help him cope.

articles.title: Philippe Diallo Launches Campaign for FIFA Presidency Against Infantino
articles.summary: French Football Federation president Philippe Diallo has formally kicked off his bid to unseat Gianni Infantino as FIFA president. Diallo, backed by UEFA, stated he has already gathered strong encouragement from continents outside Europe and plans to seek an alliance with fellow presidential hopeful Kozo Tashima to strengthen his challenge.

articles.title: JJ Gabriel Confirms Departure from Manchester United Ahead of Move
articles.summary: Young talent JJ Gabriel has officially confirmed his exit from Manchester United through an emotional farewell video. The forward, who arrived at the club as a ten-year-old in 2020, requested the cancellation of his registration prior to turning sixteen and is widely anticipated to complete a transfer to Real Madrid.

articles.title: Sarina Wiegman Extends England Deal and Names Fresh Talents
articles.summary: Lionesses manager Sarina Wiegman has extended her England contract through to the end of the 2029 European Championship, citing excitement over promising youth. Alongside the renewal, Wiegman introduced uncapped players Isobel Goodwin and goalkeeper Katie Cox to her squad for the upcoming two-legged World Cup qualifying clash against Ukraine.

articles.title: Documentary Offers Fresh Look at England Versus Argentina 1986
articles.summary: A newly released documentary titled The Match re-examines the famous 1986 World Cup quarter-final between England and Argentina. Former striker Gary Lineker and other key figures revisit the iconic contest, with filmmakers uncovering unseen photographs and untold perspectives to present the historic drama to modern audiences.

articles.title: Janine Van Wyk Details Bleak Conditions at 2006 Wafcon
articles.summary: In an excerpt from her autobiography, former South Africa captain Janine van Wyk recalled the harsh logistical difficulties faced during the 2006 tournament in Nigeria. Van Wyk described arriving at empty accommodation completely devoid of essentials, lacking basic amenities such as functioning mattresses, lightbulbs, and running water.

articles.title: Max Dowman Breaks Records as England U21s Beat France
articles.summary: England under-21 prospect Max Dowman delivered an outstanding performance, scoring the decisive goal in challenging weather conditions at Ashton Gate to beat France. Dowman's display saw him surpass a scoring milestone previously established by Jude Bellingham, capturing headlines despite the presence of Ethan Mbappé on the pitch.

articles.title: Old Park Star Makes Chasing Debut at Ffos Las
articles.summary: Prominent novice hurdler Old Park Star is set to make his official debut over fences today at Ffos Las. The highly anticipated contest will see the Supreme hero renew his competitive rivalry against familiar opponent Sober Glory in public for the first time over larger obstacles.

articles.title: Formula 1 Heads to Las Vegas with Three Rounds Remaining
articles.summary: The 2026 Formula 1 championship enters its decisive stage this weekend with the running of the Las Vegas Grand Prix. The event marks the start of a demanding final triple-header, leaving competitors just three opportunities to resolve remaining title ambitions and standings battles.

articles.title: Ten-Man Portugal Edge Wales in Five-Goal Cardiff Thriller
articles.summary: Wales concluded their Nations League group fixtures with a 3-2 loss against Portugal in Cardiff. The visitors managed to secure the victory despite being reduced to ten men following the dismissal of Chelsea attacker Pedro Neto, leaving Wales empty-handed after an entertaining contest.

articles.title: Australia and England Battle in Deciding Hobart ODI
articles.summary: Australia and England are facing off in the decisive third one-day international at Hobart's Ninja Stadium. With the series on the line, both nations are competing for overall victory in the final encounter of the three-match bilateral series.

articles.title: Exciting Chase Action Scheduled for Ffos Las on Wednesday
articles.summary: Racing enthusiasts are anticipating an intriguing chase debut at Ffos Las, which benefits after cancellations elsewhere. Established rivals Old Park Star, Sober Glory, and Baron Noir are scheduled to go head-to-head over fences, drawing expert analysis ahead of the competitive jumps showcase.

articles.title: WBC Confirms Support for Heavyweight Unification Bout in 2027
articles.summary: The World Boxing Council has declared full support for a heavyweight title unification fight planned for 2027. Under this proposed plan, their reigning heavyweight champion would face off against the winner of the blockbuster showdown between British rivals Tyson Fury and Anthony Joshua.

articles.title: JJ Gabriel Confirms Old Trafford Departure Ahead of Madrid Switch
articles.summary: Young attacker JJ Gabriel has officially confirmed his departure from Manchester United. The promising teenager announced he is parting ways with the English club in order to pursue the next chapter of his development, with a transfer to Spanish giants Real Madrid nearing completion.

articles.title: Alexander Zverev Defeats Ben Shelton to Reach ATP Finals Semis
articles.summary: Alexander Zverev secured his place in the semi-finals of the ATP Finals in Turin with a straight-sets victory over Ben Shelton. Zverev closed out the encounter 6-2 7-6 (7-4), repeating his triumph from their previous meeting in this year's US Open final.

articles.title: Arsenal Near Contract Extensions for Raya, Timber and Hincapie
articles.summary: Arsenal are close to finalizing new contract agreements with key defensive figures David Raya, Jurrien Timber, and Piero Hincapie. The Gunners hierarchy is actively working to conclude the paperwork to protect the long-term future of their defensive core.

articles.title: Jockey Nico de Boinville Provided Security Escort Following Threat
articles.summary: Jockey Nico de Boinville received security protection at Plumpton racecourse on Monday after a threat against his safety was reported. Following the alert, racecourse staff and security escorted the rider safely to his vehicle, and the matter has been handed over to relevant authorities.
